units.title: Le temps et la suite des choses

words.eg: Ring me {as soon as} you know either way.
{By the time} we got there the good seats had gone.
{In the meantime}, carry on as if nothing had changed.
We can talk about it {afterwards}, not in front of them.

no.after: « After » attend un complément. Tout seul, en fin de phrase, il faut « afterwards ».

words.eg: It starts in April; {until then} nothing is decided.
{From then on} she checked everything twice.
{No sooner} had we sat down than the fire alarm went off.
Two things were true {at the same time}, which is usually the problem.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces mots ordonnent deux moments. Lequel les superpose ?
odd.why: « At the same time » ne met rien avant ni après.

words.eg: It is too late, and {besides}, nobody wants to.

no.beside: « Beside » sans s veut dire à côté de. L’argument en plus, c’est « besides ».

words.eg: She runs the team {as well as} half the client relationship.
{On top of that}, the licence expires in June.
The first version was slow {whereas} the second is simply wrong.
It works. {However}, nobody can explain why.
It rained all week. {Even so}, we went out every day.
{On the other hand}, it does mean we can start in March.
{Despite} the forecast, the whole thing went ahead.

no.despite of: « Despite » se passe de « of » : « despite the rain », ou « in spite of the rain ».

odd.prompt: Trois de ces mots opposent. Lequel ajoute ?
odd.why: « As well as » empile ; les trois autres contredisent.

words.eg: The delay was {due to} something nobody would name.
{Owing to} the weather, the whole thing moved indoors.
Write it down {so that} the next person does not start again.
We split it in two {in order to} get half of it signed off.
Two people left and {as a result} the deadline moved.
The data is incomplete and {therefore} the conclusion is too.
Nothing happens {unless} somebody asks twice.

no.except if: « Unless » remplace « if not » à lui seul, et sonne bien plus naturel.

words.eg: It is fine {as long as} you tell them before Friday.

odd.prompt: Trois de ces mots relient une cause à un effet. Lequel annonce une intention ?
odd.why: « So that » dit le but visé, pas la cause subie.
